  <script id="cc-l1-scene-architecture">
(function(){
 const source={"wall":"data:image/png;base64,","garage":"data:image/png;base64,","garage-frame":"data:image/png;base64,","side":"data:image/png;base64,","side-frame":"data:image/png;base64,","lamp":"data:image/png;base64,","exterior-garage":"data:image/png;base64,","exterior-side":"data:image/png;base64,"};
 const loaded={};
 for(const [name,data] of Object.entries(source)){
   const im=new Image();loaded[name]=im;im.src=data;
 }
 // All architecture objects live on the native Phaser scene, not a DOM/canvas overlay.
 window.__ccBuildLevel1=function(sc){
   if(sc.__ccL1SceneBuilt)return;
   if(!Object.entries(loaded).every(([k,im])=>im.complete&&im.naturalWidth)){
     if(!sc.__ccL1AssetRetry){sc.__ccL1AssetRetry=true;
       Promise.all(Object.values(loaded).map(i=>i.decode())).then(()=>{
         sc.__ccL1AssetRetry=false;
         if(sc.sys?.isActive?.())window.__ccBuildLevel1(sc);
       }).catch(()=>{sc.__ccL1AssetRetry=false;});}
     return;
   }
   const get=(key)=>{const k='cc-l1-independent-'+key;
     if(!sc.textures.exists(k))sc.textures.addImage(k,loaded[key]);return k;};
   const add=(key,x,y,depth=0.05)=>sc.add.image(x,y,get(key)).setOrigin(0,0).setDepth(depth);
   // The floor at depth 0 and the entire wall at depth .01 are separate native Phaser layers.
   const wall=add('wall',0,0,.01);
   const openGarage=add('exterior-garage',124,36,.04);
   const openSide=add('exterior-side',301,36,.04);
   const garageFrame=add('garage-frame',121,27,.08);
   const sideFrame=add('side-frame',297,30,.08);
   const garageDoor=add('garage',121,27,.09);
   const sideDoor=add('side',297,30,.09);
   const lamps=[48,212,418].map(x=>add('lamp',x,0,.1));
   sc.__ccL1Objects={wall,openGarage,openSide,garageFrame,sideFrame,garageDoor,sideDoor,lamps};
   sc.__ccL1SceneBuilt=true;
   sc.__ccSyncDoors=function(){
     const open=sc.dayPhase&&sc.dayPhase()==='open';
     openGarage.setVisible(open);openSide.setVisible(open);
     garageDoor.setVisible(!open);sideDoor.setVisible(!open);
     return open;
   };
   sc.__ccSyncDoors();
   sc.events.on('update',sc.__ccSyncDoors);
   sc.events.once('shutdown',()=>{sc.events.off('update',sc.__ccSyncDoors);sc.__ccL1SceneBuilt=false;sc.__ccL1Objects=null;});
 };
})();
</script>
